top_factors.title: Heavy Rainfall
top_factors.reason: Heavy rainfall can delay harvesting, damage crops, slow transportation, and reduce market supply. These disruptions often increase supply uncertainty and amplify the Bullwhip Effect.

top_factors.title: Demand Surge
top_factors.reason: Demand is significantly higher than normal. If inventory cannot satisfy customer demand, panic ordering and stock shortages may occur.

top_factors.title: Severe Weather
top_factors.reason: Extreme weather conditions increase operational uncertainty and frequently disrupt logistics, farming, and distribution.

top_factors.title: Fuel Cost Impact
top_factors.reason: Higher fuel prices increase transportation costs and may delay deliveries throughout the supply chain.
